segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כׇּל עֲרָיוֹת, אֶחָד גָּדוֹל וְאֶחָד קָטָן – קָטָן פָּטוּר, אֶחָד עֵר וְאֶחָד יָשֵׁן – יָשֵׁן פָּטוּר, אֶחָד שׁוֹגֵג וְאֶחָד מֵזִיד – שׁוֹגֵג בְּחַטָּאת וּמֵזִיד בְּהִכָּרֵת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» This mishna cites an additional difference between the status of an espoused maidservant and the status of forbidden relatives. In «all» cases of intercourse with «those with whom relations are forbidden,» if «one is an adult and one is a minor,» the «minor is exempt;» if «one is awake and one is sleeping,» the «sleeping» one is «exempt;» if «one» commits the act «unwittingly and one» does so «intentionally,» the one who did so «unwittingly» is liable «to» bring «a sin offering and» the one who did so «intentionally» is liable to be punished «with karet.» By contrast, in a case of intercourse with an espoused maidservant, the man is liable to bring a guilt offering only if the woman is flogged, and that is the case only if she was an adult, awake, and committed the sin intentionally.

moves.cueHe: כל עריות אחד גדול ואחד קטן

positions.claim: in arayot the minor and the sleeper are exempt; the unwitting brings a sin offering and the intentional is liable to karet
